premise: At the rock pool Lola starts a game: who has the most arms? She has two, Starfish five, and Octopus, wiggling every one, eight.
inspiration: The counting-rhyme contest (the folk 'who has more' game) made true: each friend wins a count, and the biggest number belongs to the octopus.
lesson: Everyone is made differently, and counting together is fun.
learning: An octopus has eight arms, and most starfish have five.

en-US.title: Who Has the Most Arms?
en-US.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola came to the edge of the rock pool and peeked in. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] "Who's at home today?" {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Up came Octopus, orange and curly. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Then Starfish, {starfish:face happy} smiling. {girl:says} [playfully] "Let's play a game. Who has the most arms?" {girl:live wave} Lola went first. One, two. Two arms! {starfish:live stretch} Starfish stretched out wide. One, two, three, four, five. {girl:face surprised} Five arms! [short pause] Then Octopus {octopus:live dance} wiggled all of his. {girl:says} [excited] "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven… EIGHT!" {octopus:face happy} Eight arms! Every octopus has eight. {girl:says} [laughs] "You win, Octopus!" [warmly] But two arms are just right for clapping, said Octopus. {girl:live clap} So Lola clapped, Starfish cheered, {octopus:live twirl} and Octopus twirled round and round, all eight arms swirling.

es-ES.title: ¿Quién tiene más brazos?
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola se acercó a la charca de las rocas y miró dentro. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] «¿Quién hay hoy en casa?» {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Salió Pulpo, naranja y rizado. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Y luego Estrella, {starfish:face happy} muy sonriente. {girl:says} [playfully] «¡Vamos a jugar! ¿Quién tiene más brazos?» {girl:live wave} Empezó Lola. Uno, dos. ¡Dos brazos! {starfish:live stretch} Estrella se estiró bien. Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco. {girl:face surprised} ¡Cinco brazos! [short pause] Entonces Pulpo {octopus:live dance} meneó todos los suyos. {girl:says} [excited] «Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete… ¡OCHO!» {octopus:face happy} ¡Ocho brazos! Todos los pulpos tienen ocho. {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Has ganado, Pulpo!» [warmly] Pero dos brazos son perfectos para aplaudir, dijo Pulpo. {girl:live clap} Así que Lola aplaudió, Estrella lo celebró {octopus:live twirl} y Pulpo giró y giró, con sus ocho brazos al vuelo.
